description.zh: 是否全部删除，仅当未传入tagkey.n时有效。取值范围：-true-false
description.en: Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter is valid only when `TagKey.N` is not specified. Valid values: `true` and `false`.

description.zh:
资源类型
instance 节省计划实例
description.en: The resource type. Set the value to `instance`. This value indicates a savings plan instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi untag-resources --resource-type instance --all true --resource-id spn-xxxxxx --tag-key codename --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All true --ResourceId.1 'spn-xxxxxx' --TagKey.1 codename --ResourceType instance
